project_type: Legacy Swift 5/SwiftUI iOS 17 Xcode project plus a new Python 3.11 FastAPI/RAG package, deterministic data-preparation pipeline, and optional external Lightning AI QLoRA tooling
language: Python 3.11 (primary backend/data/training), Swift 5/SwiftUI, Bash, YAML, JSON
build_system: No Python manifest exists yet. Introduce uv with pyproject.toml and committed uv.lock; use a src/acharya package and dependency groups for retrieval, training, and development. Keep the existing Xcode 15 project and remove all SwiftPM dependencies. Machine has uv 0.12.18; Python 3.11.15 is available through PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 rather than a direct python3.11 executable.
test_framework: Introduce pytest/pytest-asyncio with unit, integration, network-blocked, external-network, macOS, and GPU markers; Ruff and mypy are required checks. Add an XCTest target for DTO/client/view-model tests, but run it only on macOS. Linux uses scripts/validate_xcodeproj.py plus pytest structural tests.
build_command: PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv lock --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild --check && PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv sync --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild --frozen --extra retrieval --extra training --group dev
test_command: PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv run --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild pytest -q /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/tests; final local orchestration is bash /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/scripts/verify_all.sh
verification_instructions: First run frozen install, Ruff, mypy, and non-external pytest suites. Then run scripts/verify_gate_a.sh, which must build the real bundled PDF twice, calibrate raw-BM25 lexical support, restart the API under inherited network denial, return a cited extractive response, and abstain on adversarial questions. Run prepare-handoff --strict twice to fetch/cache the exact three Kaggle versions and verify deterministic corpus/SFT/report hashes; if access fails, retain redacted execution evidence and mark Gate B blocked. Build/evaluate the actual full retrieval index where model access permits. Run provider-check against the existing .env.local only through the application, with Kiro tools disabled and a minimal redacted record. On Linux run project-reference validation only; run xcodebuild tests solely on macOS. Build and clean-extract the deterministic transfer bundle, run pinned full-history Gitleaks, and leave Gate C PENDING_EXTERNAL_GPU because no GPU training is allowed here.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock is tracked. data/raw, data/processed/<fingerprint>, artifacts/preparation/<fingerprint>, artifacts/indexes/<fingerprint>, artifacts/provider-check, artifacts/gates, model caches, adapters/checkpoints, and dist/lightning/*.tar.zst are generated and ignored. Preparation writes corpus.parquet, corpus.jsonl, train.jsonl, validation.jsonl, test.jsonl, observed schemas, reconciliation/dedup/split/token reports, data card, attribution, raw inventory, and SHA256SUMS. Bundle generation writes BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json and copy/upload inventory inside the archive. The stale Swift Package.resolved is deleted because all packages are removed.
environment_constraints: Worktree is /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild on branch feature/rag-rebuild at setup commit 4dc9d9e and was clean during planning. Always use git -C /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild for Git; never use the worktree as process cwd. Linux x86_64 host has 8 CPUs, 30 GiB RAM, about 90 GiB free disk, Swift 6.3 for Linux, Docker/Podman, kiro-cli 2.26.0, and no xcodebuild, zstd, gitleaks, kaggle executable, or visible NVIDIA GPU. Do not run GPU training. /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/.env.local exists and is secret: never open, display, copy, quote, source in a shell, or commit it; the provider-check implementation may load it directly and must emit only allowlisted metadata.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING file, or .kiro/steering guidance exists. README is currently two lines and there is no existing build/test command. Preserve codes/Pipeline_OpenAI.ipynb unchanged as historical reference and preserve iOS assets/visual style. Never commit credentials, raw Kaggle archives, processed corpora, indexes, model weights, adapters, checkpoints, or generated reports/bundles. Use only non-secret test sentinels. CI must fetch full history and run Gitleaks 8.24.2 with redaction. Never claim a dataset fetch, Xcode build, Kiro call, GPU run, or quality gain without execution artifacts.
key_patterns: The repository is mostly greenfield for Python: there are no Python source files, manifests, or tests. Follow the approved direct-module architecture rather than LangChain. The only Swift sources are AcharyaGPT_iOS_App.swift and ChatbotView.swift; ChatbotView imports Alamofire and references missing types. project.pbxproj contains twelve out-of-repository source references plus ChatGPTSwiftAcharya and Alamofire package products, and Package.resolved contains their transitive pins. The bundled PDF is 60,371 bytes, SHA-256 ae5a30200145559dbd0b7ce25b58e6f1a31c272b98743d8a72353a0ddfbc5322, six pages, and every extracted page has word-per-line structure requiring the locked repair rules. Gate A must be extractive-only and network-independent; optional generation requires calibrated claim entailment and whole-candidate fallback; Gate C is non-blocking.
directory_structure: Existing roots: AcharyaGPT(iOS)/ contains the app/project/assets, codes/ contains one legacy notebook, and data/ contains the bundled PDF. Add configs/ and prompts/ for immutable inputs; src/acharya/{ingest,rag,providers} for production modules; training/ for SFT/QLoRA/export; eval/ for golden/calibration inputs; tests/{unit,integration,fixtures,network_block}; scripts/ for verification, packaging, iOS validation, and Lightning orchestration; ignored artifacts/, data/raw, data/processed, checkpoints/adapters, and dist/lightning for execution outputs.
